result.summary: Round limit reached, so I made no edits. I read both Codex findings and checked them against the memo (lines 70-114). I agree with both. The memo's wording goes beyond its evidence on geometry and on reuse rights. The fixes are listed below for the maintainer. I did not re-run any source retrieval this round.

responses.evidence: Memo lines 82-94 name Adamawa, Bauchi, Kwara and Opobo divisions as 'split between modern states', but the memo does not set out the comparison with modern ADM1 boundaries. Codex's logic is also right. A historical division split across modern states does not show that a union of modern units cannot rebuild a historical state. Only a specific historical state boundary that cuts through a modern unit would show that. The memo documents no such case. What it does show is that the schedules use provinces, divisions and districts, which are finer than ADM1. So an ADM1 merge is unverified, not ruled out. Line 94's 'Not supported' and 'ADM1-based geometry is not justified' are stronger than that.
responses.action_taken: No edit (round limit). Proposed wording for the maintainer: 'The schedules are written at province, division and district level. I did not compare them with modern ADM1 boundaries, so whether 1967 and 1976 states can be rebuilt by merging ADM1 units is unverified. If it is attempted, each state should carry an approximate label, and a cross-cutting case should be documented before ADM1 geometry is relied on.' Line 94 would become 'Unverified; needs a boundary comparison'.

responses.evidence: The gazette rights rows record that no licence was read (the about page returned 403). Line 98 then says gazette scans are 'likely not freely reusable'. That is a guess with no checked licence or legal source behind it, and INSTRUCTIONS.md allows 'unknown' but prohibits guessing. The same line also says all five leads have 'unknown or all-rights-reserved terms'. The all-rights-reserved part is only supported where a copyright footer was actually read, which the memo records for at most some sources.
responses.action_taken: No edit (round limit). Proposed wording for the maintainer: 'Rights for the gazette scans, the Government Printer, the UT PCL map and Archivi.ng remain unknown. Each needs a check of the host's terms and Nigerian copyright law before any use on the page.' This keeps the rights check already listed as item 6 under 'What still needs a source'.
